comment: Cases for extractMessageArgs in internal/gateway/message_text_test.go (the gateway reads a message call's params; the OpenClaw plugin sends them and cuts nothing it does not have to). rel-1-0-10:GAP-0177, GAP-0290..0292, GAP-0436. gen builds a large input: strings N short strings in blocks; table N rows of two cells; nodes N empty objects in one array followed by one string; nodes_empty N empty objects; depth N nested objects around one string; depth_empty N nested objects around an empty array; pad N: body of N a's and text of N z's; multibyte N two-byte characters in text; plainbuf N repeats of five-character words under buffer; routing_strings N recipients in to beside text x; payload_buffer N / payload_dataurl N base64 characters of binary bytes under buffer / behind a data URL under media (message hi beside each); payload_then_text N base64 characters plus ' tail words' in buffer; dataurl_message N groups behind a data URL in message; nested_buffer N groups under attachments[0].Buffer; payload_text N / payload_text_dataurl N / payload_hidden: attachments that decode to text. Routing keys are dotted paths; a repeated path gets #2, #3. text_len counts UTF-8 bytes. Blank means ASCII white space only. Synthetic values only.
